title: Cloud Qualification Audit
description: Per-split unit qualification evidence for the G-ROSTER eligibility inequality; verdicts are derived, never stored. One record covers exactly one benchmark family, because SWE root-lineage qualification and tau2 task qualification are different evidence and neither substitutes for the other.

benchmark_family.description: swe qualifies root lineages by base-commit licence evidence; tau2 qualifies individual tasks drawn from the pinned objective pool. A record of one family is never evidence for the other.

tier.description: The registered tiers. No family-specific tier exists and none may be introduced here.

proxy_basis.description: Which pool proxy_units counts. For swe only base_commit_admissible bounds eligibility from above; for tau2 only pinned_objective_pool is meaningful.

split.description: One split of one family. proxy_units and eligible_units count root lineages for swe and tasks for tau2; the unit is fixed by benchmark_family and is never mixed within a record.

fixed_reserve.description: Manifest-fixed reserve for this split. null means no authority has fixed it, which is NOT the same as zero and must fail closed rather than be assumed away.

hamilton_allocation.description: Registered Hamilton allocation for this split. DL-128 requires one for C160 but fixes no number, so null must fail closed rather than be read as zero.

registered_minimum_units.description: A floor the registered design states directly, independent of the inequality — DL-128 requires at least 47 qualified airline tasks for tau2 C160. null means no such floor is registered for this split, which is a genuine state and unlike an unfixed reserve does not fail closed. Where a floor exists the requirement is the greater of it and the inequality.
